top3.venue_address: 140 N Christopher Columbus Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19106
top3.selection_address: 140 N Christopher Columbus Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19106
top3.why: A restaging of Anna Halprin's 1967 Blank Placard Dance, in which a silent procession carries empty protest signs through the city and turns the question of what to protest back on the passersby who ask.
